points.sentence: In-progress can also mean Blotato found no record for that id, so it does not prove the post exists or failed.

points.point: saved submission id: is it right
points.sentence: Please check that the id came from the original create response.
A long wait is not proof it failed, so please do not post it again yet.

points.point: where to look for a failure
points.sentence: Failed posts are also listed at https://my.blotato.com/posts?status=failed, so please look there too.

verdict.reason: The customer has only polled a status that stays in-progress, and this entry says what in-progress can mean and what to do next. Its sentences are general, so they cover the Bluesky video case.
